name: MVGS_INCLUSION_DECISION
title: MV-GenomSeq indication board decision
description: Decision of the multidisciplinary case conference in the field of diagnostics (indication board) on the inclusion of the insured person in the Modellvorhaben Genomsequenzierung: created = decision date, one activity 'genome sequencing in the Modellvorhaben' that is scheduled (included) or cancelled with the rejection reason (not included). Status values record the decision at `created`, not the later execution. No MII profile exists (mii-pr-onko-tumorkonferenz requires an oBDS Tumorkonferenz type and therapy-type activities).
